svg.title: ANet palette (light)
svg.desc: Tech gray, black, white and signal red. Graphite gray ramp 50-950, red ramp 50-950 anchored on the logo red #E93024, and the status treatments: success neutral, warning red signal, failure solid red.

text.font-family: 'Archivo', 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tech gray · Black · White · Signal red — red only marks what matters
